startup_failed.km: មិនអាចបើក SvaType បានទេ។ សូមបើក Windows ឡើងវិញ។
startup_failed.en: SvaType cannot start. Please restart Windows and try again.

webview_missing.km: ត្រូវដំឡើង WebView2។ សូមប្រើ SvaType-Setup-Full-x64.exe ពី USB។
webview_missing.en: Microsoft WebView2 is missing. Run SvaType-Setup-Full-x64.exe from your USB drive, then start SvaType again. No internet is required.
